entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? I... I need to make a return, please.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. I can certainly help you with that. Could I get your name and order number to start?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti, order number 775-019-2B. I just feel so bad about this, I've never had to return anything before.

No problem at all, Maria. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the TrailGuard Helmet. I understand you want to return it. To make sure I handle this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, there's nothing wrong with the helmet itself. It's just... the color wasn't what I expected, and it doesn't match my new bike at all. The box is still unopened. It's just been sitting here, and honestly, with the holidays coming up, I really needed this money back. I've been a loyal customer for so long.

I completely understand, and I appreciate you calling. Let me just check the purchase date here... Okay, I see it was delivered 67 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return policy for standard items. I can absolutely process this return for you right now.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief. I was so worried it had been too long. Thank you.

Of course. We want you to be happy with your gear. And since the box is unopened and I see you're a VIP member with us, I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email on file right now. I'm also adding a $20 VeloFit credit to your account for your loyalty. Your safety on the trails is our top priority, and we want to make sure you get a helmet you love wearing.
Wow, a credit too? That's so generous. You've really turned my day around, Charlie. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome, Maria. The email with the label should be in your inbox. Just attach it to the package and drop it off. Once we scan it in at our warehouse, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for being so helpful.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and ride safe.
